bullets.text: Voice AI Revolution - **ElevenLabs** leads the charge in making synthetic speech mainstream at **TechCrunch Disrupt 2025**.
YouTube Dubbing Feature - **YouTube** launches multi-language audio dubbing, expanding creators' global reach.
iPhone Air Insights - **Apple** executives discuss the design vision and unique features of the new **iPhone Air**.
Sleep Score Compatibility - **Apple Watch** introduces Sleep Score feature, compatible with third-party devices.
AI Companion Regulation - California moves to regulate **AI** chatbots to protect minors and vulnerable users.
OpenAI's Cloud Deal - **OpenAI** signs a historic $300 billion cloud computing deal with **Oracle**.
Parental Control App - **Sony** launches PlayStation Family app for enhanced parental controls on gaming.
AI Model Consistency - **Thinking Machines Lab** aims to improve AI model responses with reproducibility.
Starlink's Ambitious Vision - **Elon Musk** envisions **Starlink** as a potential replacement for traditional cellphone carriers.
Klarna's Successful IPO - **Klarna** raises $1.4 billion in its IPO, marking a significant milestone for the fintech.
